item.title: Learning About Microservices
item.description: This is a ongoing summary of the book “Building Microservices” by Sam Neuman. Chapter 1 - What are microservices From the book: Microservices are small, autonomous services that work toggether. Breaking it down we get: Small - in terms of code base and team. Autonomous - separate entities, deployed as a independent service. Communication between services are through network calls. Thoughts are made about what is exposed vs hidden.
